title: Junior Test Automation Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a passionate Test Automation Engineer to join our team developing next-generation autonomous vehicle technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for building robust automation frameworks and creating data-driven dashboards to ensure the quality, reliability, and safety of our vehicle functions.
If you are excited about autonomous driving, test automation, and transforming complex test data into actionable, real-time insights using tools like Grafana, we'd love to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable automated test scripts and test frameworks for safety-critical vehicle functions.


Create and manage Grafana dashboards to visualize test results, system health, and quality KPIs for cross-functional teams.


Integrate automated testing pipelines with data visualization and monitoring tools to provide real-time feedback during the development lifecycle.


Analyze system and software requirements to define and implement effective automated test strategies.


Execute automated tests in simulation and target environments (CI/CD integration).


Perform detailed log analysis and evaluate test results, utilizing dashboards to quickly identify defects, anomalies, and root causes.


Collaborate with system engineers, developers, and safety engineers to ensure comprehensive automated test coverage and clear reporting.


Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies, automation processes, and telemetry/reporting infrastructure.

Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.


Proven experience in software test automation and building automated test frameworks.


Hands-on experience creating, configuring, and maintaining Grafana dashboards for monitoring, reporting, and data visualization.


Strong proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, C++, or similar.


Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating test automation into continuous integration workflows.


Experience analyzing logs, interpreting large datasets, and troubleshooting complex system behaviors.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Preferred
Familiarity with time-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, Prometheus) commonly used alongside Grafana.


Experience in automotive software development or testing.


Experience with safety-critical systems (ISO 26262, ASPICE, or similar standards).


Familiarity with autonomous driving systems, ADAS, sensor technologies, or vehicle control systems.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company description:
Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.
Job description:  Let's introduce ourselves 
We are looking for a highly skilled Boxcar and data Engineer to join SWTC. This role combines hands-on test environment ownership with system-level integration and verification, ensuring robust and scalable validation of rig environment and related systems. You will play a key role in maintenance and quality assure simulation environments, and hardware test rigs (boxcars) while collaborating across engineering domains.
 What you'll do 
Test Environment Ownership
  Develop, maintain, and operate Boxcar, related data and system set-up
 Ensure availability, stability, and scalability of rig
 Support test execution, troubleshooting from environment perspective, and continuous improvement
 Support automation and efficiency improvements
  
Boxcar & Hardware Setup

 Integrate ECUs, networks, and supporting infrastructure into test setups
 Ensure correct vehicle architecture replication in lab environments
 Troubleshoot hardware, communication interfaces, and system behaviors
  
System Integration & Verification
  Support end-to-end system integration across multiple domains
 Collaborate with developers and test teams to verify software and feature functionality
 Identify and resolve integration issues early in the development cycle
 Contribute to root cause analysis and defect resolution
  
Collaboration & Stakeholder Interaction
  Work closely with Tech Leads, Architects, developers, testers, and infrastructure teams
 Support cross-team alignment for test environment readiness and usage
 Contribute to knowledge sharing and improved ways of working
  
Continuous Improvement
  Drive improvements in:
  Health checks in rig, computer and system
 System reliability
 Environment utilization and reliability
  Contribute to evolving SWTC test strategies and capabilities
 Promote best practices in integration, validation, and system understanding
    Profile description: What you'll bring

  Experience in:
  Embedded systems, automotive software, or system integration
 Test environments (VIL, HIL, SIL, or similar)
 Hardware setups and ECU/network integration
  Strong understanding of:
  Vehicle electrical/system architecture
 CAN, Ethernet, or similar communication protocols
  Hands-on troubleshooting skills across hardware and software domains
 Experience with test automation and scripting (e.g., Python and CAPL)
  
Preferred Qualifications
  Experience with boxcar rigs or similar lab-based test environments
 Knowledge of continuous integration / continuous testing workflows
 Familiarity with Volvo Cars tools, processes, and SWTC environment
 Experience supporting Windows new images or test environment infrastructure migrations
  
Key Competencies
  Strong system thinking and integration mindset
 Ability to work in complex, cross-functional environments
 Proactive, structured, and solution-oriented
 Clear communication and collaboration skills
